275510945.description:
JVC MiniDV DVC Video Tapes Lot - 8 Pieces
Model DVM60ME, 60 Minute SP / 90 Minute LP
Digital Era
This lot features eight factory-sealed JVC MiniDV (DVC) digital video cassettes, designed for use with digital camcorders. These tapes were a staple of the consumer and enthusiast digital video transition in the late 1990s and early 2000s, offering high-quality digital recording on a compact magnetic medium. They remain essential for videographers maintaining vintage camcorder hardware or for those looking to record in a native digital-tape format.
Items Included:
1.
8 JVC MiniDV Tapes
- Model DVM60ME (also identified as M-DV60DU), 60-minute standard play capacity, factory-sealed.
Format: MiniDV / DVC Digital Video Cassette
Recording Capacity: 60 minutes (SP mode) / 90 minutes (LP mode)
Anti-static lid design for error-free recording
Made in Japan
Condition:
All eight tapes are new and factory-sealed in their original plastic wrap. The outer gold and blue cardstock packaging is intact with only minor shelf wear on the corners. As these are vintage magnetic media, long-term shelf stability is typical for the format, though they are sold as-is. Plastic wrap is tight and unopened across all units.

Blue Druzy Geode Slice with Gold Gilded Edge

Natural crystal geode slice with deep blue dye enhancement and gold-tone gilding
Wood-grain finish shadowbox frame with protective glass front

Integrated sawtooth hanger on the reverse for easy wall mounting
Measures approximately 16" H x 12" L x 3" W
